issue.title: Album UI e2e schema-field-jump-ctrl-j leaves the field selection unchanged
issue.description: Real athena Obsidian fails Stats Ctrl+J -> stats (field 1 field:status; real key moved=false) on unchanged pre-kit 36d4801 and every kit phase. Repro: BOB_BIN=<checkout-built bob-cli 5b4c2636 debug bob> TMPDIR=/tmp/<short> xvfb-run -a node scripts/obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs -e /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian. Ownership final 120/121, same sole album failure in chrome report file:explicit:57b7adc6f806ce185b185519. Determine whether real event dispatch/focus or product navigation is wrong; preserve the real Ctrl+J assertion and field-selection semantics. Root cause is not established, so large size requires diagnosis/planning.
